blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Southeast Asian governments and parliaments need to build on the Digital Economy Framework Agreement that the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) has just signed by deepening their cooperation on digital trade and strengthening safeguards for the use of artificial intelligence. House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III made the call on Sunday as president of the Asean Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (Aipa) when he delivered his address at the 15th Asean–Aipa Leaders’ Interface at the Philippine International Convention Center in Manila at the opening of the 49th Asean Summit.
